description: He wears an ivory ankle-length tunic with long sleeves and gold-and-dark embroidered bands around the neckline, down the front, at the cuffs and along the lower hem. The tunic fits a broad rounded abdomen beneath a decorated belt. A deep plum long outer robe with broad gold floral and geometric borders drapes from the shoulders, with a round purple-centered gold clasp near one shoulder. A long dark and gold belt tail with layered fringed ends hangs at the front. Dark brown leather shoes emerge below the hem.
